entries.name: Small pothole

dimensions.typical: < 30 cm across, < 25 mm deep (RoadOS classification proposal)

entries.description: Shallow localised loss of surface material.

entries.name: Medium pothole
entries.description: Pothole large enough to jolt cars and destabilise two-wheelers.

entries.name: Large pothole
entries.description: Pothole occupying a large part of a wheel path.

entries.name: Deep pothole
entries.description: Pothole with depth capable of tyre, rim or suspension damage.

entries.name: Water-filled pothole
entries.description: Pothole hidden under standing water; depth cannot be judged visually.

entries.name: Multiple potholes
entries.description: Cluster of potholes across one or more lanes.

entries.name: Long pothole
entries.description: Elongated trench-like pothole along the direction of travel.

entries.name: Edge pothole
entries.description: Pothole at the carriageway edge, often where two-wheelers ride.

entries.name: Road cracks
entries.description: Longitudinal, transverse or alligator cracking of the surface.

entries.name: Broken asphalt
entries.description: Fragmented bituminous surface with loose pieces.

entries.name: Uneven resurfacing
entries.description: Step or ridge between old and new surfacing layers.

entries.name: Sunken manhole
entries.description: Manhole cover set below the road surface.

entries.name: Open manhole
entries.description: Uncovered manhole — a fall and wheel-trap hazard.

entries.name: Open drain
entries.description: Uncovered drain channel at or across the road edge.

entries.name: Broken drain cover
entries.description: Cracked or missing drain grating.

entries.name: Road depression
entries.description: Localised sag of the surface that may hold water.

entries.name: Road rutting
entries.description: Longitudinal grooves in the wheel paths.

entries.name: Road erosion
entries.description: Edge or surface washed away by water.

entries.name: Broken concrete
entries.description: Cracked or spalled concrete pavement slabs.

entries.name: Damaged bridge joint
entries.description: Damaged or protruding joint at a bridge deck.

entries.name: Road subsidence
entries.description: Sinking of a road section due to ground failure.

entries.name: Shoulder drop-off
entries.description: Height difference between pavement edge and unpaved shoulder.
